4 · Publish to Speckle

Each BimDataFrame as a new version of a model on a Speckle server, in the site CRS's coordinates, so that the models fit together there. Choose a model for each BimDataFrame to publish; one without a model is left out. Nothing is sent until Publish is pressed. The notebook signs in with this machine's Speckle account for the server. Without one, paste a personal access token with the scopes profile:read, streams:read and streams:write into the field that appears: it stays in this notebook's memory and is never written to disk. Setting SPECKLE_TOKEN before starting the notebook fills the field.
